summary: FreeScout is a self-hosted customer support platform that provides shared mailbox and ticketing functionality. It serves as an open-source alternative to commercial help desk services like Zendesk and Help Scout. The application handles incoming emails and converts them into trackable support threads for team collaboration.
goodFor: Teams looking to migrate their shared inbox and customer support operations from proprietary SaaS platforms to their own infrastructure.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence carries strict copyleft obligations if you modify the code and distribute it or offer it as a hosted service to third parties.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for attachments and database files, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
